answer_1.quote: We evaluate the edited model on four tasks from the GLUE benchmarks—sentiment analysis (SST2), paraphrase detection (MRPC), natural language inference (NLI) and linguistic acceptability classification for doing downstream evaluation.
answer_1.outputs: The generated outputs include text generations used to compute normalized entropy and downstream task predictions such as sentiment labels, paraphrase detection, NLI, and linguistic acceptability.

answer_2.quote: The simplest metric to identify such a model collapse is to calculate the entropy over the probability distribution of vocabulary elements of text generated from the model.
